title: QUIZ - 26
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Recall the standard relationship between length units
questions.question: In length measurement, 1 meter is equal to how many of the smaller unit?
questions.hint: Recall the standard metric relationships between common units of measurement.

questions.learningObjective: Recall the standard relationship between mass units
questions.question: How many of the smaller unit are in 1 kilogram (a mass measurement)?
questions.hint: Recall the standard metric relationships between common units of measurement.

questions.learningObjective: Apply a standard length unit relationship to convert a specific quantity
questions.question: If 1 meter = 100 centimeters, how many centimeters are in 5 meters?
questions.hint: Multiply the given amount by the number of smaller units per larger unit.

questions.learningObjective: Combine measurements given in two different but related units into one unit
questions.question: A trail is 6 kilometers and 150 meters long. What is the total length in meters?
questions.explanation: Convert kilometers to meters: \(6 \times 1000 = 6000\). Add the remaining meters: 6000 + 150 = 6150 meters.
questions.hint: Convert the larger unit portion to the smaller unit first, then add the remainder.
